strings.phase2.a3.common.quotes_note: Nothing is charged by choosing. Every step shows its price before you commit, and you are charged exactly that price.
strings.phase2.a3.common.leave_note: Leaving early uses up the period, charges the time you spent and earns no learning.
strings.phase2.a3.common.mode.foreground.hint: A live exercise with a time budget. At most two a day, and a lesson you start cannot be taken back.
strings.phase2.a3.common.mode.routine.hint: For a kind of exercise you have mastered: it counts as a sound exercise, with the normal learning, when you record the period.
strings.phase2.a3.common.mode.attend.hint: Supervised instruction with the normal learning. It does not count as a new exercise.

strings.phase2.a3.investigate.subtitle: Find the fault: run tests, read the evidence, then name the cause or report honestly.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.beat.isolate: Step 1: Isolate. Run the tests you can afford; each one rules causes in or out.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.beat.conclude: Step 2: Conclude. Name the cause, or report that the fault is not isolated. Reporting is free.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.test.done_positive: Run: positive. The fault is among the causes it implicates.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.test.done_negative: Run: negative. The causes it implicates are ruled out.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.cause.guess: Other causes still stand, so naming this one is a guess.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.report.action: Report that the fault is not isolated
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.report.hint: An honest report costs nothing and ends the exercise.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.report.isolated: The evidence already leaves only one cause standing.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.role.inspector: Your part: inspector (observing tests are cheaper)
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.role.experimenter: Your part: experimenter (measuring tests are cheaper)
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.role.repairer: Your part: repairer (swapping tests are cheaper)
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.role.critic: Your part: critic (an honest report is your job)
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.scarce.equipment: Short on: instruments (measuring tests cost 1 more)
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.scarce.parts: Short on: spare parts (swapping tests cost 1 more)
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.scarce.access: Short on: access (observing tests cost 1 more)
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.goal.inspect.hint: Observing tests are cheaper this lesson.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.goal.measure.hint: Measuring tests are cheaper this lesson.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.goal.swap_parts.hi: Swapping tests are cheaper this lesson.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.outcome.reported: You reported that the fault was not isolated.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.outcome.tests: Tests run: {0}. Wasted: {1}. Causes still standing at the end: {2}.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.fail.wrong_cause: The cause you named was not the fault.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.fail.unsupported: You named a cause while other causes still stood: the evidence did not support it.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.fail.redundant: You ran a test whose answer the earlier tests had already settled.
strings.phase2.a3.investigate.fail.abandoned: You reported that the fault was not isolated when the evidence had isolated it.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.subtitle: Plan the group's work: give out the tasks, talk to your classmates, settle what binds you, hand over together.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.beat.assign: Step 1: Assign. Give every task to someone who suits it and can carry it.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.beat.exchange: Step 2: Exchange. Talk to classmates one at a time to learn what they know.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.beat.settle: Step 3: Settle. Choose how the group deals with what binds it.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.beat.submit: Step 4: Submit. Check that the parts join, or hand in as it stands.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.role.scribe: Your part: scribe (the hand-over check is cheaper)
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.scarce.attention: Short on: attention (each conversation costs 1 more)
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.scarce.materials: Short on: materials (the hand-over check costs 1 more)
Assigning the tasks is cheaper this lesson.
Conversations with classmates are cheaper this lesson.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.goal.settle_constra: Settling the constraint is cheaper this lesson.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.goal.submit_cleanly: The hand-over check is cheaper this lesson.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.tasks_heading: Tasks (press a task to give it to the next person)
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.task.unsuited: {0}, but this task does not suit them
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.assign.incomplete: Give every task to someone first.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.exchange.finish_hin: Moves on to settling. Finishing costs nothing.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.facts_none: Nobody has told you anything yet.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.resolution.reschedu: Move who does what, and when.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.resolution.trim_sco: Cut what the group promised to do.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.resolution.ask_exte: Ask the teacher for more time.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.submit.check_hint: Looks for places where the parts do not join.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.submit.plain_hint: Costs nothing. Anything that does not join stays unfound.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.submit.done: The group plan is handed in.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.outcome.counts: Overloaded people: {0}. Tasks with the wrong person: {1}. Key facts never heard: {2}. Wasted conversations: {3}.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.fail.overloaded: Someone was given more work than they can carry.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.fail.mismatched: A task went to someone it does not suit.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.fail.uninformed: A classmate held a key fact that you never heard.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.fail.unsettled: What binds the group was left, or settled the wrong way.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.fail.seam: The parts did not join, and the hand-over was not checked.
strings.phase2.a3.coordinate.fail.wasted: Effort went on a conversation or a check that found nothing.
